subject: PaperWorks onboarding — vendor record merge & bank update
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace Chen <grace@paperworks.com>, accounting_ops@paperworks.com
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: PaperWorks onboarding — vendor master checklist & initial questions

Hi Grace —

Thanks for moving forward with Redwood. To get PaperWorks set up in our vendor master and aligned with PO/payment flows, can you confirm the following items this week? I’ve attached a short onboarding_checklist.xlsx for reference.

1) Legal entity name (as it appears on W-9)
2) Remit / payment address (we currently have: 412 Willow St., Unit 2, San Francisco, CA 94107 — please confirm)
3) Tax ID / W-9 (signed PDF)
4) Bank account details for ACH (bank name, account last 4 digits, routing) — we treat full account numbers as secure; you can send a redacted PDF attachment or upload to our secure DocuSign flow (link at bottom)
4a) Any early-payment discount / invoice terms you require (Net30, Net45, etc.)
5) Any existing Redwood supplier number(s) you think we should be merging (we sometimes get duplicates created by sales)

One note from our side: during a brief data validation we flagged what looks like a duplicate supplier record (two entries with similar names, different addresses) — if you have a preferred supplier ID, please let us know so we can merge and avoid duplicate POs.

Next steps from my side after your reply: open a vendor merge ticket with Ops, route bank details to AP for verification, and kick off the DocuSign route for secure W-9 submission if needed.

Attachments: onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Grace Chen <grace@paperworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounting_ops@paperworks.com
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 13:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PaperWorks onboarding — vendor master checklist & initial questions

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — attaching the signed W-9 and a PDF with our bank details. Please note the remit address on our records changed last month: the correct billing/remit address is

PaperWorks Co.
Attn: Finance – AP
78 Harbor View Drive
Portsmouth, NH 03801

We also discovered a duplicate supplier entry in your system. A prior pilot sale created a record under "Paper Works LLC" (note the space) with a different address. Our accounting team prefers the record you create under the legal name shown on the W-9 (PaperWorks Co.). If merging requires a supplier number for reference, the old record is likely: SUP-7291 (created by the sales pilot).

Banking: attached is PaperWorks_BankDetails.pdf (contains bank name and account last 4 digits; we can complete DocuSign/ACH authorization if you need the full account details).

Attachments: PaperWorks_Signed_W9.pdf, PaperWorks_BankDetails.pdf

Let me know if you want me to complete anything via DocuSign — we can turn around the ACH authorization same-day.

—Grace
Grace Chen
Finance Lead | PaperWorks Co.
grace@paperworks.com
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace Chen <grace@paperworks.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, AP Team <ap-team@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PaperWorks onboarding — vendor master checklist & initial questions

Thanks Grace — and Marissa, thanks for flagging.

Action items I’ll take from here:
- I will open PR ticket PR-4321 to merge the duplicate supplier records (reference SUP-7291). Ops will handle the merge but AP needs a confirmed supplier ID to keep for future POs — Marissa, please confirm the target supplier ID you want us to keep (prefer the new "PaperWorks Co." entry).
- AP will run the banking verification once we receive the ACH authorization form. Grace, if you can complete the DocuSign ACH form via the link Marissa shared, please do; otherwise we can accept a signed bank letter.
- I will add a note to the supplier record to consolidate invoices to the Portsmouth remit address provided.

Grace — one quick ask: could you confirm the legal entity exactly as printed on the W-9 (we will use that to choose the canonical supplier name)? Also please confirm if SUP-7291 should be closed post-merge or aliased.

I’ll update the ticket once Ops schedules the merge (expect 2–3 business days) and loop in Payments to block any POs to the duplicate until merge is complete.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
AP Specialist | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace Chen <grace@paperworks.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PaperWorks onboarding — vendor master checklist & initial questions

Great — appreciate the quick turnaround, Grace.

Confirmed next steps:
- Rohan to open PR-4321 and coordinate the merge (target canonical name: PaperWorks Co.; canonical supplier record will use the W-9 name)
- Grace to complete DocuSign ACH authorization (link: https://app.docusign.com/embedded/signon?envelopeId=abc123) or send signed bank letter to accounting_ops@paperworks.com
- AP to verify bank details and update remit address to Portsmouth, NH

Rohan — please also add a one-time hold on SUP-7291 so we don’t accidentally PO to the wrong record. Evelyn — FYI for billing/forecast reconciliation.

I’ll close out once PR-4321 shows the merge done and AP confirms bank verification. Timeline: expect updates by Mon 2025-03-17.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
